note: Both sets are heavy on bare dimension strings, but Set B binds more values correctly to identifiable parts: the Module A/B segment lengths with left/right conditions (2'-3 7/8" leftmost, 2'-11 7/8"/3'-1 5/16" segments), the L3X3X1/4 angle member profile, and the 1 1/2" = 1'-0" detail scale, all of which the text layer supports. Set A never captures the L3X3X1/4 member profile or the scale, garbles one value into '4 13', and invents properties such as 'web thickness 5/8"' and 'total height from base'. Set B's weakness is invented bindings/conditions (I-beam height, base-block hole/bottom offsets, base-plate offset to center, middle-section height), so it is not clean, but its core claims are better bound and it recovers the key member-size fact.
